reference_sql:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching BE-14 lines of 2024
  SELECT ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue * n_lines), 2) AS revenue_stored,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue_unique,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) - 2397222.41, 2) AS gap
FROM line_sets

solver.query:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
),
u AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM l),
r AS (
  SELECT (SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur), 2) FROM l) AS revenue_stored,
         (SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur), 2) FROM u) AS revenue_unique
)
SELECT revenue_stored, revenue_unique, ROUND(revenue_unique - 2397222.41, 2) AS gap FROM r
